gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1503.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with WAH YU ROAD and running in a south south-west direction for about 83 metres, then it turns to run generally southerly for about 146 metres where it bends to run in a south south-easterly direction for about 67 metres then it turns again to run southerly for about 286 metres and then bends to run in a south-westerly direction for about 61 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R84B. Proposed Name: LAI CHI LING ROAD. Chinese Version: 荔枝嶺路.

No. 1503.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with LAI CHI LING ROAD and running westerly for about 85 metres where it bends to run in a north north-westerly direction for about 201 metres and then it turns to run north north-easterly for about 277 metres to terminate at its closed end which is a turning circle as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R84B. Proposed Name: LAI KONG STREET. Chinese Version: 荔崗街.

No. 1503.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with LAI KONG STREET and running north-westerly for about 100 metres, then it curves to run in a northerly direction for about 43 metres and then turns to run north-easterly for about 79 metres then it bends to run in a northerly direction for about 41 metres where it terminates at its closed end as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R84B. Proposed Name: LAI FUNG STREET. Chinese Version: 荔峰街.

No. 1503.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Street commencing at its junction with KWAI TAI ROAD and running in a north north-westerly direction for about 91 metres, then it turns to run north north-easterly for about 332 metres to terminate at its junction with KWAI HEI STREET and WING SHUN STREET as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R84B. Proposed Name: KWAI YUE STREET. Chinese Version: 葵裕街.

No. 1503.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with KWAI HEI STREET and KWAI YUE STREET and running in a north-westerly direction for about 253 metres where it turns to run north north-westerly for about 155 metres, then it bends to run in a northerly direction for about 125 metres and then it turns to run north north-easterly for about 143 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R84B. Proposed Name: WING SHUN STREET. Chinese Version: 永順街.

No. 1503.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: The continuation of KWAI HEI STREET from its junction with WING LAP STREET as a thoroughfare, which was published under Government Notice No. 2859 dated 25 November 1977, and running in a south south-westerly direction for about 177 metres where it turns to run south-westerly for about 137 metres to terminate at its junction with KWAI YUE STREET and WING SHUN STREET as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R84B. Proposed Name: KWAI HEI STREET. Chinese Version: 葵喜街.

No. 1503.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with WING KEI ROAD and running in a westerly direction for about 55 metres, then it bends to run southerly for about 247 metres where it terminates as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R84B. Proposed Name: WING HAU STREET. Chinese Version: 永孝街.
